name: Flow Calibration — Supervised Trial
author: Decent
description: Helps the machine’s flow estimate match your scale, with automatic calibration or a manual value for each profile. Trial version: supervise all changes.

Enabled.label: Enable calibration changes
Enabled.description: Allow automatic and manual changes on the selected DE1. Trial use only: wait for each update before starting another shot. Keep the older automatic calibration plugin disabled.

ExpectedSerial.label: DE1 serial number
ExpectedSerial.description: Only this machine can be calibrated. Leave blank to prevent changes.
